text:
laura: Heads-up — planning a small rollout of inference-router v2.3 tomorrow at 16:00 PT (UTC-7). Diego will do the deploy. It includes a KV cache tweak and a batching opt; low-risk but needs observability checks.

diego: Confirmed. I'll start at 16:00 PT. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~30m with 10m between steps.

meera: What exactly do you want on the obs checklist? dashboards / traces / alerts?

laura: Short checklist: 1) add `batch_size` label to key latency panels, 2) add a kv_cache_hit_rate panel, 3) bump trace sampling for batcher spans and add `deploy_id` tag, 4) temporarily suppress the noisy 5xx alert during rollout window. Smoke tests: health endpoint, synthetic prompt, tail canary 200s, p95 latency + error checks.

jamie: I can own dashboards. I'll add `batch_size` legend and a KV panel. Dash link (staging): https://dash.redwood/inf-router/staging. Will push a PR.

oliver: I'll patch tracer config to add `deploy_id` and increase sampler for 60m around rollout. Will also add a quick span filter for `batcher.*`.

sre-bot: Alert rule to be adjusted (Prometheus expr):
```
expr: (sum(rate(http_request_total{service="inference-router",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_request_total{service="inference-router"}[5m]))) > 0.05
```
Proposal: change threshold to `> 0.10` for 30m to avoid noisy pages during the rollout. Will annotate change in PagerDuty.

diego: Rollback criteria: if canary errors > 2% OR p95 latency > 1200ms for >5m, roll back immediately. Who is watching dashboards / traces?

laura: Meera + Jamie watch dashboards, Oliver watches traces, Diego is primary deployer. I'll be on-call.

meera: I'll run synthetic checks at +5m and +20m marks and post results. Synthetic command: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood/v1/prompt -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'` and check status + latency.

jamie: Dash PR created: #4589 — added `batch_size` and kv_cache_hit_rate panel in staging. Tagging @laura for a quick review.

laura: Quick note — please add an annotation to the rollout duration on the dashboard so we can correlate spikes. Also add `snooze:30m` to PD rule `inference-router-5xx` during rollout.

oliver: Tracing config updated in staging, sampler increased. Will flip in prod at rollout start.

deploy-bot: Diego started canary rollout at 2026-03-18T23:00:00Z -> 5% traffic.

diego: Canary @ +10m: p95=480ms, errors=0.3%. No red flags, moving to 25%.

sre-bot: Changed alert threshold for `inference-router-5xx` from 5% -> 10% for 30m (annotation: rollout/v2.3).

meera: Synthetic check +5m: latency p95=500ms, errors=0.1% — all good.

laura: OK to proceed to 100% if no regressions in next 10m.

diego: Moving to 100% now, monitoring for 15m.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed: 100% traffic at 2026-03-18T23:30:00Z.

jamie: Dashboards look stable. kv_cache_hit_rate steady at ~98%. `batch_size` breakdown shows expected distribution.

oliver: Traces show `deploy_id` present and batcher spans normal. No slow traces flagged.

meera: Final synthetic at +30m: p95=510ms, errors=0.2%.

laura: Nice work all — I'll lift PD snooze and restore alert threshold in 20m. Thanks :tada:

sre-bot: Alert threshold restored to 5% at 2026-03-18T23:50:00Z per annotation rollout/v2.3.

diego: Closing rollout ticket #7891. Ping me if anything odd surfaces.

laura: Closing thread, leaving notes in the release doc and canary readout. Great coordination everyone. :rocket:
